name: Vera Blanc: Ghost In The Castle
source:
In the second episode, our heroine travels to a small village in central Italy. The town's legendary ghost seems like nothing more than a quaint story, but a string of murders and suicides all point to the castle's ghost, and locals are getting scared.

[From [url=http://www.winterwolves.com/verablanc.htm]Winter Wolves[/url]]
translation:
在第二章中，女主角前往義大利中部的一個小村莊。當地傳說中的幽靈乍看只是個古老的鄉野傳說，但接連發生的命案與自殺事件都指向城堡裡的鬼魂，居民們也開始感到恐懼。

[出自[url=http://www.winterwolves.com/verablanc.htm]Winter Wolves[/url]]
